example_sentences.de: Im Sommer gehen wir fast jeden Tag ins Freibad.
example_sentences.en: In summer we go to the outdoor pool almost every day.

example_sentences.de: Das Freibad öffnet erst im Mai.
example_sentences.en: The outdoor pool doesn't open until May.

cloze.de: Der Eintritt ins ___ kostet für Erwachsene fünf Euro.
cloze.en: Admission to the outdoor pool costs five euros for adults.

words.notes: frei (open-air) + Bad (bath). Open only in the warm months, unlike the year-round Hallenbad.
words.mnemonic: Bathing under the free open sky: frei + Bad.
words.germany_context: Nearly every town runs a municipal Freibad, usually open May to September. A Saisonkarte pays for itself after about eight visits, and many pools sell cheap Feierabendtickets after 5 p.m.

example_sentences.de: Im Winter schwimme ich jeden Dienstag im Hallenbad.
example_sentences.en: In winter I swim at the indoor pool every Tuesday.

example_sentences.de: Das Hallenbad hat auch am Montag geöffnet.
example_sentences.en: The indoor pool is open on Mondays as well.

cloze.de: Wo ist das nächste ___ in dieser Stadt?
cloze.en: Where is the nearest indoor pool in this city?

words.notes: Halle (hall) + Bad. The counterpart to the summer-only Freibad.
words.mnemonic: A Halle with water in it: Hallen-Bad.
words.germany_context: Hallenbäder split the day into public hours and Schwimmerzeiten reserved for clubs and school classes, so check the Belegungsplan online before going. Flip-flops in the changing room are expected.

example_sentences.de: Nach dem Schwimmen gehe ich gern in die Sauna.
example_sentences.en: After swimming I like to go to the sauna.

example_sentences.de: Die Sauna ist heute leider geschlossen.
example_sentences.en: Unfortunately the sauna is closed today.

cloze.de: In der ___ sitzt man immer auf einem Handtuch.
cloze.en: In the sauna you always sit on a towel.

words.notes: Plural is die Saunen; die Saunas is also heard in everyday speech.
words.mnemonic: Same word as in Turkish and English, but feminine: die Sauna.
words.germany_context: German saunas are textilfrei: you go in naked with a towel to sit on, and most sessions are mixed-gender. Swimwear is actually forbidden for hygiene reasons; many pools offer a Damentag if that is more comfortable.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe meinen Schlüssel im Fundbüro abgeholt.
example_sentences.en: I picked up my key at the lost and found office.

example_sentences.de: Das Fundbüro der Stadt ist nur vormittags geöffnet.
example_sentences.en: The city's lost and found office is only open in the mornings.

cloze.de: Frag doch mal im ___ nach deinem Regenschirm.
cloze.en: Why don't you ask at the lost and found office about your umbrella?

words.notes: From finden (to find) — der Fund is a found object.
words.mnemonic: Fund (a find) + Büro (office) = the office of found things.
words.germany_context: Anything lost on a bus, tram or train goes to the transport company's own Fundbüro first and only moves to the städtisches Fundbüro after a few weeks. Deutsche Bahn runs a separate one, searchable online for a small fee.

example_sentences.de: Ich bringe den Anzug in die Reinigung.
example_sentences.en: I'm taking the suit to the dry cleaner's.

example_sentences.de: Die Reinigung hat meinen Mantel noch nicht fertig.
example_sentences.en: The dry cleaner's hasn't finished my coat yet.

cloze.de: Hol bitte das Hemd aus der ___ ab.
cloze.en: Please pick up the shirt from the dry cleaner's.

words.notes: Also means 'cleaning' in general. The shop is properly die chemische Reinigung.
words.mnemonic: rein (clean) + -ung, and every -ung noun is feminine.
words.germany_context: Dry cleaning is pricey (a suit around 15 euro) and usually takes two to three working days. Most Reinigungen also do alterations, which is handy since German trousers rarely come hemmed.

example_sentences.de: Am Samstag fahren wir zum Wertstoffhof.
example_sentences.en: On Saturday we're driving to the recycling centre.

example_sentences.de: Der Wertstoffhof nimmt alte Farbe und Elektrogeräte an.
example_sentences.en: The recycling centre accepts old paint and electrical appliances.

cloze.de: Den kaputten Fernseher kannst du kostenlos zum ___ bringen.
cloze.en: You can take the broken television to the recycling centre free of charge.

words.notes: Wertstoff = recyclable material, Hof = yard. Also called Recyclinghof or Wertstoffzentrum.
words.mnemonic: A Hof (yard) where Wertstoffe (materials with value) go.
words.germany_context: Electronics, paint, wood and scrap metal do not belong in the Mülltonne — take them to your district's Wertstoffhof, which is free for residents with an Ausweis. For furniture you instead book a Sperrmüll pickup with the city, usually once or twice a year for free.

example_sentences.de: Unser Auto steht in der Tiefgarage.
example_sentences.en: Our car is in the underground car park.

example_sentences.de: Die Tiefgarage gehört zum Haus.
example_sentences.en: The underground car park belongs to the building.

cloze.de: Für einen Stellplatz in der ___ zahlen wir 60 Euro im Monat.
cloze.en: We pay 60 euros a month for a space in the underground car park.

words.notes: tief (deep) + Garage. Compare das Parkhaus, which goes upwards.
words.mnemonic: A deep (tief) Garage under the building.
words.germany_context: A Tiefgarage space in a city block is rented with its own contract, separate from the flat, usually 50 to 150 euro a month. Ask about it during the Besichtigung, because spaces are often gone before the flat is.

example_sentences.de: Mein Bruder geht seit drei Monaten in die Fahrschule.
example_sentences.en: My brother has been going to driving school for three months.

example_sentences.de: Die Fahrschule liegt direkt neben dem Bahnhof.
example_sentences.en: The driving school is right next to the station.

cloze.de: Ein Führerschein bei einer deutschen ___ kostet oft über 3000 Euro.
cloze.en: A licence at a German driving school often costs over 3000 euros.

words.notes: fahren (to drive) + Schule. The lessons are Fahrstunden, the theory part is der Theorieunterricht.
words.mnemonic: A Schule where you learn to fahren.
words.germany_context: A German licence from scratch costs roughly 3000 to 4500 euro. A Turkish licence can normally be exchanged (umgeschrieben) at the Führerscheinstelle, but only within six months of your Anmeldung — after that you may need the theory and practical tests again.

example_sentences.de: Mein Auto ist gerade in der Werkstatt.
example_sentences.en: My car is at the garage right now.

example_sentences.de: Die Werkstatt repariert auch Fahrräder.
example_sentences.en: The workshop repairs bicycles too.

cloze.de: Ich muss den Wagen morgen in die ___ bringen.
cloze.en: I have to take the car to the garage tomorrow.

words.notes: Irregular plural: die Werkstätten. For cars people also say die Autowerkstatt or die Kfz-Werkstatt.
words.mnemonic: Werk (work) + Statt (place) = the place where work happens.
words.germany_context: Every car needs a TÜV inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) every two years; most Werkstätten do the test and the repairs in one appointment. Book by phone — walk-ins are rarely taken.

example_sentences.de: Die türkische Botschaft ist in Berlin.
example_sentences.en: The Turkish embassy is in Berlin.

example_sentences.de: Ich muss zur Botschaft, um meinen Pass zu verlängern.
example_sentences.en: I have to go to the embassy to renew my passport.

cloze.de: Für ein Visum brauchst du einen Termin bei der ___.
cloze.en: You need an appointment at the embassy for a visa.

words.notes: Also means 'message'. A country has one Botschaft in the capital and several Konsulate elsewhere.
words.mnemonic: Every noun ending in -schaft is feminine: die Botschaft.
words.germany_context: Turkey's Botschaft is in Berlin, with Generalkonsulate in cities like Cologne, Munich, Hamburg and Frankfurt. Passport, Nüfus and military-service matters are handled by the consulate responsible for your Bundesland, by online appointment only.

example_sentences.de: Deutschland hat sechzehn Bundesländer.
example_sentences.en: Germany has sixteen federal states.

example_sentences.de: In welchem Bundesland wohnst du?
example_sentences.en: Which federal state do you live in?

cloze.en: Bavaria is the largest federal state in Germany.

words.notes: Bund (federation) + Land. Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen are cities and Bundesländer at the same time.
words.mnemonic: das Land is neuter, so das Bundesland is too.
words.germany_context: School holidays, public holidays and even shop rules differ by Bundesland: Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg have the most Feiertage, and only some states allow shops to open on a few Sundays a year.

example_sentences.de: Der Brief kommt vom Amtsgericht.
example_sentences.en: The letter is from the local court.

example_sentences.de: Das Amtsgericht ist für kleine Streitfälle zuständig.
example_sentences.en: The local court is responsible for small disputes.

cloze.de: Bei Streit mit dem Vermieter hilft dir das ___ weiter.
cloze.en: In a dispute with the landlord, the local court is where you go.

words.notes: Amt (office) + Gericht (court). Here Gericht means 'court', not 'dish'.
words.mnemonic: das Gericht is neuter, so das Amtsgericht is too.
words.germany_context: The Amtsgericht handles rent disputes, small claims and the Mahnverfahren for unpaid bills. A Mahnbescheid arrives in a yellow envelope and must be answered within two weeks, otherwise the claim counts as accepted.

example_sentences.de: Die Kinder spielen auf dem Sportplatz Fußball.
example_sentences.en: The children are playing football on the sports field.

example_sentences.de: Der Sportplatz liegt hinter der Schule.
example_sentences.en: The sports field is behind the school.

cloze.de: Am Wochenende treffen wir uns am ___.
cloze.en: At the weekend we meet at the sports field.

words.notes: der Platz is masculine, so every -platz compound is masculine.
words.mnemonic: Sport on a Platz: der Platz, der Sportplatz.
words.germany_context: Almost all amateur sport runs through a Verein rather than drop-in games. Joining the local Sportverein costs around 10 to 20 euro a month and is one of the easiest ways to meet Germans.

example_sentences.de: Auf dem Platz steht ein altes Denkmal.
example_sentences.en: There is an old monument on the square.

example_sentences.de: Das Denkmal erinnert an den Krieg.
example_sentences.en: The monument commemorates the war.

cloze.de: Wir treffen uns um drei am ___ vor dem Rathaus.
cloze.en: We're meeting at three at the monument in front of the town hall.

words.notes: denken (to think) + Mal (mark) — literally a thing that makes you remember. Plural: die Denkmäler.
words.mnemonic: Denk mal! Think for a moment — that is what a Denkmal is for.

example_sentences.de: In der Mitte des Platzes steht ein schöner Brunnen.
example_sentences.en: There is a beautiful fountain in the middle of the square.

example_sentences.de: Die Kinder werfen Münzen in den Brunnen.
example_sentences.en: The children are throwing coins into the fountain.

cloze.de: Treffen wir uns am ___ neben der Kirche?
cloze.en: Shall we meet at the fountain next to the church?

words.notes: Plural is identical to the singular: der Brunnen, die Brunnen. Means both a decorative fountain and a well.
words.mnemonic: Brunnen sounds like 'brine' — water in the middle of the square.

example_sentences.de: Im Sommer ist die Eisdiele immer voll.
example_sentences.en: In summer the ice cream parlour is always full.

example_sentences.de: Gehen wir nach dem Essen in die Eisdiele?
example_sentences.en: Shall we go to the ice cream parlour after the meal?

cloze.de: Vor der ___ am Marktplatz steht eine lange Schlange.
cloze.en: There's a long queue in front of the ice cream parlour on the market square.

words.notes: Eis (ice cream) + Diele (hall). One scoop is eine Kugel: 'Zwei Kugeln Schokolade, bitte.'
words.mnemonic: die Diele stays feminine in die Eisdiele.
words.germany_context: Italian-run Eisdielen open around March and close in October. A Kugel costs roughly 1.50 to 2 euro, and many of them still take cash only.
